title: Recommendation
description: Output of stage 3. One title from the candidate set, or an honest statement that nothing in the set fits.
$comment: Two rules are enforced in code rather than here. First, `title` must exactly match a title in data/candidates.json — see spec.md criterion 7. Second, every entry in `satisfies` must match the name of a motif actually returned by stage 1; the model must not invent motifs at this stage.

outcome.description: Use `no_good_fit` when nothing in the candidate set genuinely matches the motifs. Forcing a match is a failure — see reference case 4.

title.description: The recommended game. On `no_good_fit` this may name the closest candidate, or be null if nothing is close enough to be worth naming.

rationale.description: Why this game fits the motifs. On `no_good_fit`, what the candidate set is missing.

satisfies.description: Names of the stage 1 motifs this game satisfies. Empty on `no_good_fit`. Lets the rationale be checked against the motifs rather than read as generic praise.

allOf.$comment: A recommendation must name a game and satisfy at least one motif.
